abort.already_configured: This HealthPlanet website account is already configured.
abort.callback_oauth_not_supported: Callback OAuth is not supported by HealthPlanet. Use the manual authorization-code step.
abort.missing_credentials: No HealthPlanet API application is configured. One Client ID / Client Secret is shared by all family members on this Home Assistant. Follow {docs_url} first.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The selected HealthPlanet Application Credential is unavailable.

error.authorization_code_invalid: The authorization code is invalid, expired, or rejected. Generate a new code and use it within 10 minutes.
error.experimental_confirmation_required: You must explicitly accept the experimental website endpoint risk.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the supplied credentials.
error.manual_interaction_required: HealthPlanet requires browser interaction that this integration will not bypass.
error.storage_confirmation_required: You must acknowledge that Home Assistant .storage is not a dedicated encrypted password vault.
error.token_exchange_failed: HealthPlanet token exchange failed. Generate a new authorization code and try again.

user.title: Add a family member
user.description: New accounts use Hybrid: the official API supplies primary metrics and the experimental Website source supplies complementary body-composition metrics.

manual_authorization.title: Authorize this family member
manual_authorization.description: Open {authorize_url}, sign in, approve access, copy the code shown by HealthPlanet, and paste it below. The code must be used within 10 minutes. It remains in memory only and is never saved. Redirect URI: {redirect_uri}

website.title: Website credentials for this family member
website.description: This unofficial, undocumented endpoint supplies complementary metrics and may change. Website credentials are separate from the shared API Application Credential. The password is stored in Home Assistant .storage, which is not a dedicated encrypted password vault; cookies and CSRF state remain in memory only.

data.experimental_confirmed: I accept the undocumented Website endpoint risk

reauth_website.title: Reauthenticate Website source
reauth_website.description: Only Website credentials are replaced. The existing password is never prefilled.

reconfigure.title: Upgrade legacy entry to Hybrid
reconfigure.description: The existing source credentials and entity unique IDs are preserved.

init.title: HealthPlanet polling and history
init.description: Website history is fixed at the confirmed 31-day range. Official history is capped at 90 days.
